title: Signed bit laws on ordered triangulations: one twist and nothing else
claim: On ordered triangulations of closed orientable three-manifolds with one bit per edge (the setting of TWIST-3D-20261025-001A), let a signed law give each labelling of a tetrahedron's six ordered edges a weight in {-1, 0, 1}, possibly depending on the tetrahedron's orientation, and require every ordered 2-3 and 1-4 identity with factors lambda and mu. Exhaustively (complete SAT encoding, every support and sign pattern enumerated): if mu is nonzero, then up to the global sign (lambda, mu) is (1, 1), (1, 2) or (2, 16); the support is one of the seven counting supports, the same for both orientations; and up to the face gauge (a sign per face labelling, cancelling between the two tetrahedra at each face) the law is one of twelve: the seven counting laws, the twisted Dijkgraaf-Witten law (-1)^(x_01 x_12 x_23) on even cocycles, its translate on odd cocycles, and three mixed twisted laws on even-or-odd, all orientation-independent. No twisted class has a member invariant under the vertex permutations, so signs add nothing without the vertex order, as order adds nothing without signs. Laws with mu = 0 (state sum killed by every 1-4 move) and the reading with the 2-3 move alone are excluded.
failure_conditions: A signed law with mu nonzero whose factors, support or sign class lies outside the stated list.
A stated representative that fails some move identity by direct evaluation.
A disagreement between the identities generated here and those of TWIST-3D-20261025-001A.
A face-gauge copy of a twisted class that is invariant under the vertex permutations and the same for both orientations.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed Boolean state sums with one bit per edge on ordered triangulations of closed orientable three-manifolds, invariant under the ordered 2-3 and 1-4 moves; the classification of their weights and what their supports are.

validation.status: checked: the 10,880 identities equal TWIST-3D-20261025-001A's generator; all 165 factor pairs solved; supports and sign patterns enumerated to exhaustion; twelve face-gauge orbits identified with the stated representatives; representatives and random gauges pass every identity by direct evaluation; symmetry test of every gauge copy; controls fire; proof in proof.md; no human or external review
validation.novelty: the twisted law and its invariance are classical (Dijkgraaf-Witten 1990, Wakui 1992); the exhaustive census with its support statement and the order corollary: no overlap found in a bounded search of two queries on 2026-10-29 (candidate local delta)
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-29.
